content: SVG accessibility: use role=img on the svg element. Provide accessible name via aria-label on svg (simplest for self-contained diagrams), or aria-labelledby pointing to an internal title id. The title element must be first child of svg and linked with aria-labelledby for screen reader compatibility. For complex diagrams add desc with aria-describedby. Decorative SVGs: omit role=img, add aria-hidden=true. The existing pyfda diagrams already use role=img plus aria-label which is the correct minimal pattern. WCAG 1.1.1 (non-text content) requires all meaningful images to have text alternatives.
